message: I'd like the T75 Row-Crop with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery/setup. My budget is $62,500 all-in, and I can pay in full today. Can you do that?

Thanks for the clear offer and for being ready to pay in full today. The package you've picked lists at $71,300 ($68,000 tractor, $2,400 warranty, $900 delivery and setup), so $62,500 is a big step down from that. I can meet you partway: $67,500 all-in for the T75 Row-Crop with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery and setup within 150 miles. That includes the full on-site walkthrough, so you're running from day one.
Thanks. I'm comparing with another T-Series dealer. I can do $63,500 all-in right now.

I appreciate you moving up, and paying in full today does help. I can't match a quote I haven't seen, but I want to earn your business, so I'll come down again: $66,000 all-in for the T75 Row-Crop with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery and setup. That gets you the enclosed cab with A/C, four years of total coverage on parts and labor, and a full on-site walkthrough.
Meet me at $64,500 all-in and I'll check out immediately.

We're close, and I'm glad to see you moving toward a deal. Let's split the difference and finish this today: $65,200 all-in for the T75 Row-Crop with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery and setup within 150 miles. Say yes and you can check out right away.
